purpose: Current-head source/evidence audit for the next DS4 fused/retained producer step after down GPU correctness is fixed.

source_snippets.deepseek4_ref_env: src/models/deepseek4.cpp:97 deepseek4_fused_up_gate_ref_enabled() uses DS4_FUSED_UP_GATE_REF and is default-off.
source_snippets.limit_guard: ggml/src/ggml.c:3437 ggml_moe_up_gate_limit() returns explicit mul_mat_id + clamp + swiglu_split when limit > 1e-6 unless GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1.
source_snippets.cpu_fused_op: ggml/src/ggml-cpu/ggml-cpu.c:5348 ggml_compute_forward_moe_up_gate() executes GGML_OP_MOE_FUSED_UP_GATE CPU fallback.
source_snippets.cuda_fused_op: ggml/src/ggml-cuda/moe_stream_batch.cu:7396 ggml_cuda_moe_stream_up_gate_batch() executes CUDA fused up/gate path when graph op is constructed and stream is available.

cpu_fused_reject.interpretation: Disabling GGML_MOE_STREAM did not restore act-level parity. Therefore the fused up/gate mismatch is not only a CUDA stream batch issue; the CPU fused fallback path behind GGML_OP_MOE_FUSED_UP_GATE also diverges from the explicit mul_mat_id + clamp + swiglu graph. X10-O force-explicit pass remains the correctness reference.

force_explicit_pass.reason: Forcing ggml_moe_up_gate_limit through its explicit graph fallback produced exact act-level parity. Therefore DS4 branch wiring and clamp semantics are correct; the mismatch in X10-N is isolated to the real GGML_OP_MOE_FUSED_UP_GATE execution path.

allow_fused_reject.decision: reject_not_sota; no source change; do not benchmark-promote GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1 until a future patch makes layer-0 act parity exact.

explicit_default_guard.decision: Accept and push as a correctness guard for future DS4 fused/ref work. Do not claim any token-rate improvement. Real limited fused op can still be tested deliberately with GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1, but must pass act parity before any benchmark.

implementation.behavior: For limit > 1e-6, ggml_moe_up_gate_limit returns explicit mul_mat_id + clamp + swiglu_split unless GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1 is set. Existing limit=0 callers and default SOTA path are unchanged.

source_audit_conclusion: The DS4 producer entry exists only behind DS4_FUSED_UP_GATE_REF=1 and is default-off.
For DS4 layers with swiglu clamp limit, current ggml_moe_up_gate_limit deliberately avoids GGML_OP_MOE_FUSED_UP_GATE unless GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1 is set.
Reopening the real fused op is numerically unsafe today: it fails act parity even with GGML_MOE_STREAM=0, so the mismatch is also in CPU fused fallback, not only CUDA.
The exact forced-explicit subgraph passes act parity and is therefore the only safe producer reference for future retained dataflow.

next_impl_implication.preferred_route: Build a default-off explicit-retained producer/consumer scaffold that preserves explicit mul_mat_id + clamp + swiglu_split math while retaining GPU-resident activation for down; do not use real GGML_OP_MOE_FUSED_UP_GATE as benchmark path until parity is fixed.
next_impl_implication.first_gate: Any future patch touching real fused op must make DS4_FUSED_UP_GATE_REF=1 + DS4_FUSED_UP_GATE_REF_DEBUG_EXPLICIT=1 + GGML_MOE_UP_GATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_FUSED=1 pass act parity with max_abs_sum_diff=0.0 before token-rate tests.
next_impl_implication.alternative_gate: If implementing explicit-retained dataflow instead, parity must compare against forced-explicit output, then fixed-text top1, then France correctness, then calibration/dev prompt set before held-out.

decision: No source change and no SOTA change. This closes real fused-op benchmarking for now and narrows next source work to explicit-retained dataflow or a real fused parity fix.
